docs.summary: Preserves a member's or type's previous serialized name across a rename. On a **field**: old serialized data stored under [`oldName`](#api~Prowl.Echo.FormerlySerializedAsAttribute~oldName) is read into the field. On a **class/struct**: old serialized `$type` data referencing [`oldName`](#api~Prowl.Echo.FormerlySerializedAsAttribute~oldName) (the former type name) resolves to this type, so renaming a serialized type (e.g. a component script) doesn't orphan existing data. The name may be the old namespace-qualified name or the old short name.
